tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Use this when someone asks what Arcnin does. Returns the public product overview, supported agents, privacy model, and links to the website and support.

tools.name: get_downloads
tools.description: Use this when someone wants to install Arcnin. Returns the current version, official macOS and Windows installer URLs, and the system requirements for each platform.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Use this when someone asks if Arcnin is free or wants to compare plans. Returns preview availability, planned monthly USD prices, and the features in each plan.

tools.name: get_documentation
tools.description: Use this when someone needs source documentation about the public API, desktop privacy, pricing, or support. Returns the published page as Markdown.
